name: @dsh-agent/dsh-agent-memory
description: Agent-facing long-term memory for DSH. Four narrow tools — memory_remember, memory_recall, memory_expand, memory_prune — over a human-readable NDJSON file that survives across sessions. Recall returns a compact 10-column index and never the body; fetch bodies explicitly by id. There is no automatic topical recall: only a one-line index and a stable rule enter context, so content requires an explicit memory_recall call. Writes are validated fail-closed, atomic, and capped by record and byte limits with score-based eviction. Zero runtime npm dependencies (only the host-provided @deepseek-ai/cordis and @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools peers).
